subject: CFRelease

observation.summary: CFRelease appears in the exported-symbol trie of the macOS 27.0 (build 26A5388g) arm64e CoreFoundation image, UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692. The framework ships as a stub bundle on macOS 27 (no on-disk Mach-O), so the trie was read through dyld_info rather than otool/nm. On this image is the polymorphic release entry point.

claim: CFRelease is an exported symbol of the macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation image at the offset shown in the excerpt, so it is part of the linkable ABI surface.
reproducer:
CF=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation
dyld_info -uuid "$CF"            # expect UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692
dyld_info -exports "$CF" | grep -E '[[:space:]]_CF(GetTypeID|Equal|Hash|Retain|Release|GetRetainCount|CopyDescription|GetAllocator)$'
